scope: Diagnostic audit only; C1 numerical protocol, estimands, checkpoints and outcomes immutable
states: Wine split0, init0..4, true/random; same instrument for all ten
radius: exact nominal radius saved by C1, including diagnostic radius for rejected states; never recalibrate at higher resolution
boundary_onset: Each DOP853 resolution/phase: 128 equally spaced positive radii up to nominal R; first nonsimple boundary bracket refined 28 bisections; no extrapolation beyond nominal R; absence gives censored observation, not global proof
jacobi: Exact Gaussian curvature along exact geodesic: j''+K*j=0,j(0)=0,j'(0)=1. Intrinsic Dexp singular values are 1 and abs(j/r); signed determinant j/r. Solve augmented geodesic/Jacobi system with inherited DOP853 tolerances. Flat and unit-sphere analytic controls required.
jacobi_root: first positive sign-changing zero per sampled angle via dense solution and Brent xtol1e-12; minimize first zero over the bracket around each lowest sampled angle with bounded angular search xatol1e-8; no claimed lower bound on global injectivity from finite angular samples
jacobi_crosscheck: Compare signed j/r against angular centered differences of geodesics at finest boundary mesh on 65 radii; metric signed area determinant divided by r; angular differences are diagnostics only
area_embed: First boundary-loss radius from continuous radial family; degree5 exact-metric area quadrature at lower simple bracket, 32 and64 rings, on 8192 and16384 boundaries. At no loss by R report right-censored A_embed at least area at R numerically; never change C1 A=0.02
topology: All nonadjacent intersecting segment pairs using spatial index; endpoint touches retained; segment indices, interpolated angles and coordinates; signed chart area, polygonized face areas, face winding numbers and origin winding; chart areas explicitly not intrinsic areas

classification.GEOMETRIC_NONINJECTIVITY: Persistent transverse crossing at both phases for 8192 and16384 and RK4 256/512, crossing-position relative change <1e-3 of boundary diameter; plus stable negative Jacobi determinant or sign-changing zero before R (conjugate-minimum relative change <1e-3 between512 and1024 angular grids). Numerical evidence, not rigorous interval certification.
classification.NUMERICAL_FAILURE: Crossing disappears at all finest phases and RK4 levels with no convergent Jacobi loss, or identified and demonstrated implementation error; must diagnose before correcting C1
classification.INCONCLUSIVE: Otherwise or incomplete numerical matrix; no threshold retuning

bounds: r_inj <= any numerically established conjugate radius or same-radius two-ray collision. Report numerical upper estimates separately from certified bounds; global equality and cut locus not asserted.
cost_policy: Checkpoint every run. Numerical exceptions and infeasible16384 runs retained as missing and classification conservative; no replacement states.
